at_rest.evidence: Cloudflare Pages stores deployment assets on Cloudflare-managed infrastructure encrypted at rest; Cloudflare holds an AICPA SOC 2 Type II attestation (Security/Confidentiality/Availability) per the Cloudflare Trust Hub - the report is NDA-gated, the attestation's existence and scope are public. Holds the PUBLIC marketing/docs site build output for soleur.ai only (Eleventy _site): no personal data, no credentials, no customer content. Every byte it holds is already served publicly by design, so at-rest encryption is not the control that matters here - integrity of the deploy path is (ADR-194, #7640).
at_rest.defends_against: Cloudflare-managed at-rest encryption of stored deployment assets against physical-media compromise in Cloudflare's infrastructure
at_rest.does_not_defend: a leaked Pages:Edit API token, which can REPLACE the deployed site wholesale; this store's real risk is integrity and supply-chain, not confidentiality - see the cf_api_token_pages scope ledger in apps/web-platform/infra/variables.tf
at_rest.live_verification: unavailable:provider-managed at-rest; SOC 2 Type II report is NDA-gated - public attestation cited via mechanism/attestation_url; no customer-side live probe of Cloudflare disk encryption

at_rest.evidence: apps/web-platform/infra/cloud-init-git-data.yml write_files: /etc/default/git-data-betterstack and /etc/default/git-data-doppler at 0600 root:root; sentry_dsn remains baked inside /usr/local/bin/git-data-emit at 0755 root:root
at_rest.defends_against: a file-read-only primitive held by the non-root `git` account (a path traversal in the transport wrapper, say), for the two 0600 files
at_rest.does_not_defend: CODE EXECUTION as any account: hcloud_firewall.git_data declares zero rules, which under Hetzner semantics is inbound-denied and egress fully open, so the whole user_data is readable from the metadata endpoint. Also does not defend the 0755 sentry_dsn copy, which the `git` account can read today. Rotation of the baked ingest token requires a host replace (user_data is ForceNew, ADR-149/ADR-152). Tracked: #7772
at_rest.live_verification: unavailable:the git-data host has never been born; no soleur-git-data server exists to probe

exception.justification: credentials baked into user_data are plaintext by construction — user_data is retrievable from the Hetzner metadata endpoint, so no on-host file mode can make them encrypted-at-rest. The two 0600 files bound a file-read-only primitive; the 0755 sentry_dsn copy predates #7460 and is bounded by nothing. Accepted on the ADR-198 capability test: every credential here has a write-only ingest ceiling. GIT_DATA_LUKS_KEY fails that test and is deliberately NOT baked.
exception.reevaluate_when: BEFORE the git-data host is born — user_data is ForceNew (ADR-149/ADR-152), so the per-source ingest token and the metadata-endpoint egress rule are free to land today and cost a destructive host replace afterwards

at_rest.evidence: apps/web-platform/infra/rung2-rehearsal/rehearsal.tf, resource "hcloud_volume" "rehearsal" (format = "ext4", no LUKS apparatus) — a deliberate byte-for-byte mirror of hcloud_volume.git_data's declaration
at_rest.does_not_defend: at-rest recovery of the detached device — which is acceptable here only because the volume is created empty and destroyed empty
at_rest.live_verification: unavailable:n/a by construction — NO user data ever reaches a rehearsal host. The volume is created empty for one boot and destroyed empty by the workflow's if:always() teardown, with a post-teardown Hetzner API assertion that no rehearsal-prefixed server survives (#7025).

exception.justification: It mirrors the PROD plaintext store BY DESIGN. Making the rehearsal volume LUKS while hcloud_volume.git_data is plaintext would rehearse a boot that does not exist — the rung-2 rehearsal's entire value is that it boots what production would boot, so its dual-volume shape has to match production's, including the part that is currently unencrypted.
exception.reevaluate_when: hcloud_volume.git_data becomes the LUKS volume (the GIT_DATA_STORE_ENABLED cutover) — at which point this mirror must move with it, or the rehearsal stops rehearsing production

Key: random_password.rehearsal_luks + doppler_secret.rehearsal_luks_key (rung2-rehearsal/rehearsal.tf), written into a SCRATCH Doppler config, never prd_git_data.

connections.connection: GitHub Actions runner -> Better Stack Logs INGEST (s2457081.eu-fsn-3.betterstackdata.com)
connections.enforced_at: scripts/zot-inventory.sh (the SOLEUR_ZOT_INVENTORY POST); URL pinned at apps/web-platform/infra/zot-registry.tf local.betterstack_logs_ingest_url

in_transit.does_not_defend: a leaked BETTERSTACK_LOGS_TOKEN (ingest-only: it can write log lines, it cannot read them); TLS protects the channel, not the credential. Also does not defend against a CI POST bypassing Vector's VRL PII scrub - every host emitter reaches this source through a Vector agent that redacts and a runner curl does not - mitigated by construction (the marker carries only counts, sizes, our own OCI repo names and digests) and asserted by a field allow-list test derived from the construction site.

connections.connection: GitHub Actions runner -> zot registry over the CF Tunnel (registry.<base> -> tcp://10.0.1.30:5000)

in_transit.tls: runner<->CF edge and CF edge<->origin connector: TLS 1.2+ (raw TCP over WebSocket). origin connector<->10.0.1.30:5000: PLAIN HTTP on the Hetzner private network, by design.
in_transit.does_not_defend: a passive on-net attacker on 10.0.1.0/24 could read image bytes on the final leg; integrity comes from cosign digest-pinning, not TLS. Also does not defend a leaked CF Access service token or a leaked zot pull credential.

exception.justification: the same private-network-only exception already recorded for 'web hosts -> zot registry' - the final leg is plain HTTP inside the Hetzner private network; image bytes are our own OCI layers and integrity is cosign-digest-pinned. Folded in here rather than deferred because #7278 adds the fifth CI caller to this leg.
exception.reevaluate_when: the registry link gains TLS, or the store is exposed beyond the private network
